title: Anxiety check
intro: Seven questions about how often you have been bothered by certain problems over the past two weeks. Your answers are not stored and are never shared with your employer.

instrument.name: Generalised Anxiety Disorder 7-item scale (GAD-7)
instrument.licence: Developed by Drs. Robert L. Spitzer, Janet B.W. Williams, Kurt Kroenke and colleagues, with an educational grant from Pfizer Inc. No permission required to reproduce, translate, display or distribute.

questions.text: Feeling nervous, anxious, or on edge
Not being able to stop or control worrying
Worrying too much about different things
Being so restless that it is hard to sit still
Feeling afraid, as if something awful might happen

bands.title: Minimal anxiety
bands.body: Your responses suggest a minimal level of anxiety. Keeping up healthy routines can help you stay on track.
bands.nextStep: Explore our wellbeing articles and tools for ideas on maintaining balance.

bands.title: Mild anxiety
bands.body: Your responses suggest a mild level of anxiety. Support is available if you would like to talk things through.
bands.nextStep: Consider exploring our self-help tools or speaking with a psychologist through your employer's programme.

bands.title: Moderate anxiety
bands.body: Your responses suggest a moderate level of anxiety. Talking to a professional soon is a good next step.
bands.nextStep: We recommend booking a confidential session with a psychologist through your employer's programme. Your employer never learns who used NestSelf or what was discussed.

bands.title: Severe anxiety
bands.body: Your responses suggest a severe level of anxiety. Talking to a professional soon is a good next step.
bands.nextStep: Book a confidential session with a psychologist through your employer's programme as soon as possible. Your employer never learns who used NestSelf or what was discussed.

disclaimer: This tool is not a medical device and does not provide a diagnosis. It is for informational purposes only. For a clinical evaluation, talk to a licensed professional. If you are in crisis, call the emergency number.

crisis.title: Need immediate help?
crisis.body: If you or someone you know is in immediate danger, call the emergency number now.
